plain_english_policy: This bill is a House Resolution (HR) urging the U.S. Congress to provide $3 million in federal funding for renovating and revitalizing the Alabama Farmers Market.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would result in an official request being sent to the U.S. Congress asking them to appropriate funds during Fiscal Year 2011 specifically for this project.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors support urging the U.S. Congress to provide $3 million in federal funding for renovating and revitalizing the Alabama Farmers Market.
evidence_quotes: "URGING THE UNITED STATES CONGRESS TO APPROPRIATE $38 MILLION FOR THE RENOVATION AND REVITALIZATION OF THE ALABAMA FARMERS MARKET."

"BE IT RESOLVED BY THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES OF THE LEGISLATURE OF ALABAMA, That we hereby urge the Congress of the United States of America... to honor and grant the request of the Jefferson County Truck Growers Association for $3 million in federal funding for the Alabama Farmers Market Renovation and Revitalization project."
